name: hstack
description: Hyunsol Park's software lifecycle: one entry skill, plan and ship workflows, and the steps they chain.

interface.shortDescription: Chain spec, tickets, review, and the pull request so you don't carry work between stages.
interface.longDescription: HStack is a personal skill package for the software lifecycle. /hstack looks at where the work is and runs /plan or /ship. /setup-hstack writes .hstack/config.yaml so the steps stay repo-agnostic.
defaultPrompt: Use /hstack to take this as far as the lifecycle can.
Use /setup-hstack and write .hstack/config.yaml for this repo.
